title: The Voluntary *Standard*
dek: Ten AI firms pledged compliance with rules the regulator is still writing. The benchmark leader nobody can access. The $40B chip with no audited performance figure.

stories.label: AI firms pledged data changes; ICO opened agentic inquiry next day
stories.headline: The regulator secured pledges it cannot verify, for standards it has not yet written.

stories.short: White House AI accord: no auditor
stories.headline: The self-policing AI accord names no auditor and requires no public disclosure.

stories.label: benchmark categories Google claims Argon leads; tied at 53 on AA Index
stories.headline: The benchmark winner is locked behind a security program. No developer API exists.

stories.label: math manuscripts pulled after sign error; one claimed 372 results
stories.headline: A proof-shaped document is not a proof. It took a retraction to establish this.

stories.label: in talks at $40-50B, up from $21B in August; no independent benchmark
stories.headline: The transformer ASIC bet is a one-way door. The valuation prices lock-in as a feature.

stories.label: pre-money valuation; Nvidia reportedly in $1B Figure AI talks
stories.headline: If Nvidia is buying into the physical AI stack, control of the pipeline is in play.

stories.label: AI-linked bonds issued by August 2026; Nvidia in $750B infra talks
stories.headline: Venture capital is no longer the primary funding mechanism for AI infrastructure.

still_signal: Every major commitment in today's issue rests on a standard the committing party wrote itself. The field has not agreed on what good looks like. It has agreed to price as if it already knows.
